component.name: Jan
component.summary: Prywatny asystent SI działający bez dostępu do sieci

description.p: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.
Features

ul.li: Local AI models: Run LLMs such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and others on your device
Optional cloud access: Connect to services like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Groq when internet-based models are required
Custom assistants: Create tailored assistants for writing, coding, summarizing and more
OpenAI-compatible API: Includes a local API server at localhost:1337 for tools expecting the OpenAI format
MCP support: Integrates the Model Context Protocol for enhanced workflows and tooling
Privacy-aware design: Jan works offline by default. Cloud access is optional and user-controlled

description.p: Jan is actively maintained by Menlo Research. Feedback, bug reports and feature requests are welcomed through GitHub.
Jan to otwartoźródłowa alternatywa dla ChatGPT, która działa w 100% bez dostępu do sieci na Twoim komputerze.

ul.li: Lokalne modele SI: Uruchamiaj duże modele językowe, takie jak Llama, Gemma i Qwen, na swoim urządzeniu.
Opcjonalny dostęp do chmury: Łącz się z usługami, takimi jak OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini i Groq, gdy wymagane są modele dostępne przez Internet.
Własne asystenty: Twórz asystenty wyspecjalizowane do pisania, kodowania, podsumowywania itd.
Interfejs API kompatybilny z OpenAI: Jan posiada lokalny serwer API, dostępny pod adresem localhost:1337, dla narzędzi zgodnych z formatem OpenAI.
Obsługa MCP: Jan obsługuje Model Context Protocol dla lepszego przepływu pracy i obsługi narzędzi.
Projekt uwzględniający prywatność: Jan domyślnie działa w trybie bez dostępu do sieci. Dostęp do chmury jest opcjonalny i pozostaje pod kontrolą użytkownika.

description.p: Aplikacja Jan jest aktywnie utrzymywana przez Menlo Research. Informacje zwrotne, zgłoszenia błędów i prośby o nowe funkcje są mile widziane za pośrednictwem platformy GitHub.

screenshot.caption: Blank Jan page with 0 threads
Pusta strona Jan bez żadnych wątków
Jan using a search MCP to gather information
Aplikacja Jan używająca wyszukiwania MCP celem zgromadzenia informacji

description.p: Backend-managed settings and credentials with OS keyring support, native web_search/web_fetch via tauri-plugin-websearch, built-in extension bundling, per-model chat template kwargs, OpenAI-compatible translating gateway with Responses API, chain-of-thought duration persistence, MCP duplicate serve guard, multi-provider API key rotation, and a large batch of chat, RAG, and desktop fixes

A visible assistant switcher with a Cmd/Ctrl+J cycle shortcut, a unified reasoning and tool-call trace timeline, per-model sampling defaults for the local API server, a larger 100MB attachment limit, plus a batch of chat, citation, markdown/LaTeX rendering, factory-reset, and Linux fixes

Experimental AMD ROCm/HIP backend on Linux, a branded phased-startup loader with faster first paint, pause/resume model downloads, a safer default context size, and a batch of chat, provider, and toast fixes
Anthropic-compatible custom providers, provider-aware sampling controls, media-only messages, an overhauled llama.cpp settings UX, and many stability and error-handling fixes

component.name: LM Studio
component.summary: Run AI models, locally and privately

description.p: LM Studio is a desktop app for running large language models (LLMs) locally on your own computer.
features

ul.li: Run Local LLMs Offline — Execute open-weight models entirely on your own device without cloud dependency.
Cross-Platform Support — Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Model Discovery & Download — Browse and download GGUF/MLX models directly from Hugging Face.
Built-in Chat Interface — Interact with local models through a clean ChatGPT-like UI.
OpenAI-Compatible API Server — Serve local models via OpenAI-style REST endpoints for app integration.
Document Chat (RAG) — Chat with local documents privately and offline.
Model Management — Organize models, prompts, presets, and configurations in one place.
Developer Tooling — Includes CLI, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, and REST
Headless Mode — Run LM Studio without GUI for servers or CI environments.
MCP Integration — Connect MCP servers and external AI workflows.
Privacy-First Design — Prompts and conversations stay on the local machine.
Hardware-Aware Optimization — GPU offloading and memory controls for better performance on limited hardware.
Multi-Model Support — Supports Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, DeepSeek, and more.
Local Network Serving — Expose local models across devices on the same network.

description.p: Loomfy records and transcribes meetings locally, using your GPU. Audio never has to leave the machine: transcription, speaker separation and search all run on device.
Features:

ul.li: Real-time transcription with speaker diarization
GPU-accelerated on-device processing (Vulkan)
Captures both your microphone and system audio
AI summaries, action items and decisions
Keyword alerts while a meeting is running
Export to PDF and Markdown

description.p: A free account is not required to record and transcribe locally. Cloud features such as AI summaries and document generation need an account and a paid plan.

Loomfy zeichnet Meetings lokal auf und transkribiert sie mithilfe Ihrer GPU. Audiodaten verlassen niemals das Gerät: Transkription, Sprechertrennung und Suche laufen vollständig lokal auf Ihrem Computer.
Funktionen:

ul.li: Echtzeit-Transkription mit Sprechertrennung
GPU-beschleunigte lokale Verarbeitung (Vulkan)
Erfasst sowohl Mikrofon als auch Systemaudio
KI-Zusammenfassungen, Aufgaben und Beschlüsse
Schlüsselwort-Benachrichtigungen während des Meetings
Export nach PDF und Markdown

description.p: Für lokale Aufnahmen und Transkriptionen ist kein Konto erforderlich. Cloud-Funktionen wie KI-Zusammenfassungen und Dokumenterstellung erfordern ein Konto und einen kostenpflichtigen Tarif.
Loomfy graba y transcribe reuniones localmente, usando su GPU. El audio nunca sale del equipo: la transcripción, la separación de hablantes y la búsqueda se ejecutan en el propio dispositivo.
Características:

ul.li: Transcripción en tiempo real con separación de hablantes
Procesamiento en el dispositivo acelerado por GPU (Vulkan)
Captura tanto el micrófono como el audio del sistema
Resúmenes con IA, tareas pendientes y decisiones
Alertas de palabras clave durante la reunión
Exportación a PDF y Markdown

description.p: No se requiere una cuenta para grabar y transcribir localmente. Las funciones en la nube, como resúmenes con IA y generación de documentos, requieren una cuenta y un plan de pago.

Loomfy enregistre et transcrit vos réunions localement grâce à votre GPU. L'audio ne quitte jamais l'ordinateur : la transcription, la séparation des intervenants et la recherche s'exécutent entièrement sur l'appareil.
Fonctionnalités :

ul.li: Transcription en temps réel avec séparation des intervenants
Traitement local accéléré par GPU (Vulkan)
Capture le microphone ainsi que l'audio du système
Résumés par IA, points d'action et décisions
Alertes de mots-clés pendant la réunion
Exportation en PDF et Markdown

description.p: Aucun compte n'est requis pour enregistrer et transcrire localement. Les fonctionnalités cloud telles que les résumés par IA et la création de documents nécessitent un compte et un forfait payant.
O Loomfy grava e transcreve reuniões localmente, usando sua GPU. O áudio não precisa sair da máquina: transcrição, separação de vozes e busca rodam no próprio dispositivo.
Recursos:

ul.li: Transcrição em tempo real com separação de vozes
Processamento no dispositivo, acelerado por GPU (Vulkan)
Captura o microfone e o áudio do sistema
Resumos com IA, itens de ação e decisões
Alertas de palavras-chave durante a reunião
Exportação para PDF e Markdown

description.p: Gravar e transcrever localmente não exige conta. Recursos em nuvem, como resumos com IA e geração de documentos, precisam de conta e plano pago.
Loomfy записывает и транскрибирует встречи локально с использованием вашего GPU. Аудио никогда не покидает компьютер: транскрипция, разделение говорящих и поиск работают прямо на устройстве.
Возможности:

ul.li: Транскрипция в реальном времени с разделением говорящих
Локальная обработка с аппаратным ускорением GPU (Vulkan)
Захват как микрофона, так и системного звука
Резюме с помощью ИИ, задачи к исполнению и решения
Оповещения по ключевым словам во время встречи
Экспорт в PDF и Markdown

description.p: Для локальной записи и транскрипции создание аккаунта не требуется. Облачные функции, такие как резюме с помощью ИИ и составление документов, требуют аккаунта и платной подписки.

description.p: Adds full interface and PDF export support for Spanish, German, French, and Russian. Includes stability improvements to audio capture and text selection.

Vollständige Unterstützung der Benutzeroberfläche und des PDF-Exports für Spanisch, Deutsch, Französisch und Russisch hinzugefügt. Enthält Stabilitätsverbesserungen bei der Audioerfassung und Textauswahl.
Añade compatibilidad completa de interfaz y exportación a PDF para español, alemán, francés y ruso. Incluye mejoras de estabilidad en la captura de audio y selección de texto.

Ajout de la prise en charge complète de l'interface et de l'exportation PDF pour l'espagnol, l'allemand, le français et le russe. Comprend des améliorations de stabilité pour la capture audio et la sélection de texte.
Adiciona suporte completo na interface e exportação de PDF para Espanhol, Alemão, Francês e Russo. Inclui melhorias de estabilidade na captura de áudio e na seleção de texto.

Loomfy now starts on Windows machines without a Vulkan runtime, instead of failing at launch. The transcription engine no longer crashes while detecting graphics cards, and the app has a new icon on every platform.

O Loomfy agora abre em máquinas Windows sem runtime Vulkan, em vez de falhar ao iniciar. O motor de transcrição não trava mais ao detectar as placas de vídeo, e o app tem um ícone novo em todas as plataformas.
Fixes transcription refusing to start on Windows machines that lack the Visual C++ runtime. On Linux, the Flatpak install link now opens in your software centre instead of being shown as text.

Corrige a transcrição que se recusava a iniciar em máquinas Windows sem o runtime do Visual C++. No Linux, o link de instalação do Flatpak agora abre na central de aplicativos em vez de ser exibido como texto.

component.name: AuthPass
component.summary: Password Manager: Keep your passwords safe across all platforms and devices

description.p: Easily and securely keep track of all your Passwords!

AuthPass is a stand alone password manager with support for the popular and proven KeePass (kdbx 3.x AND kdbx 4.x) format. Store your passwords, share across all your devices and easily find them whenever you need to login.

ul.li: All your passwords in one place.
Generate secure random passwords for each of your accounts.
Keep track of your accounts across the web.
App available for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android Phones and Tablets, Linux and Windows.
Open multiple password files at the same time (e.g. one for work, one for personal - or even share your password files with coworkers)
Open Source available on https://github.com/authpass/authpass/
Dark Theme

description.p: AuthPass stores all your passwords in the open Keepass format, exactly where you want it. It does not send your passwords to our servers. But AuthPass supports saving to:

ul.li: Any local content provider from Android
Native Google Drive Integration
Native Dropbox Integation
Native WebDAV support to store in your own NextCloud or OwnCloud (or similar)
Native Microsoft OneDrive integration

p.em: === FULL FEATURED, NO ADS, NO SUBSCRIPTION ===

description.p: As an open source project there are no artificial feature restrictions, no ads and no requirement for payments.
Contributions welcome and encouraged ;-) (Always looking for developers, translators, documentation writers, UI designer, etc. :) ), just join our discord channel: https://authpass.app/go/discord
This is an open source project which is still under heavy development, adding features. We would love your feedback via email or on the issue tracker at https://github.com/authpass/authpass/issues/
Also join the community on our discord channel at https://authpass.app/go/discord

Download all your content from Blackboard Learn to your device, without any intervention.
Sync content like text documents, spreadsheets and lecture slides, which you can later access offline.
More than 30 universities supported around the world.

description.p: Open-source and cross-platform ecosystem of apps aimed to bring iMessage to Android, Windows, Linux, and the Web!
A bug-fix release aimed at issues found during the v2.x rollout, plus a few desktop enhancements.
Enhancements

ul.li: Voice message recording, plus fixes to voice message playback (now working on arm64 too)
Settings tiles now highlight the page you are viewing in the two-column layout
The splash screen now shows migration progress and only offers to close or report once startup actually stalls
Smoother message list animations when sending
Backups & restore now fall back to local backups with an offline notice when the server can't be reached

description.p: Fixes

ul.li: Fixes state management issues with the socket connection, which could cause a stale connection status, stacked listeners, and an unnecessary amount of errors
Fixes issues with contacts not being detected or matched against handles on some devices
Fixes issues receiving notifications on some devices, caused by a faulty contact avatar path
Fixes page dimming and navigation issues in the two-column layout
Fixes some issues with skin-specific dialogs, including dialog colors on the iOS skin
Fixes Theme Studio holding on to stale state between visits
Removes the stale connection indicator setting

description.p: The desktop app catches up to v2.1.0, bringing the full set of v2.1.0 features to Linux, plus a batch of desktop-only fixes.
New Features

ul.li: Chat Stats - See tons of interesting stats about your chats (groups & DMs)
Dynamic Wallpapers - Choose between 4 different animated wallpapers, based on the conversation's current theme
Storage Analyzer - Visualize how the app is using storage and take action by selectively clearing older messages
Material 3 Expressive - The Material & Samsung skins got a bit of a revamp to better align with the M3E design language
Contact Management Page - New settings page to visualize the app's connection to your device's contacts & matching to iMessage handles

description.p: Desktop Improvements

ul.li: The splash screen now gets a close button after 3 seconds, plus a button to open a GitHub issue if startup is taking too long
The app version now lives in a more obvious spot and turns up in settings search
Saving and renaming files is far more robust inside the Flatpak and Snap sandboxes, fixing images & videos refusing to download and preferences silently failing to save
Notifications now clear properly
Ffmpeg-based video thumbnail generation

description.p: Enhancements & Improvements

ul.li: Adds a way to sync all messages for a particular chat
URL Preview widget has been redesigned to improve its reliability & efficiency
Improved image processing pipeline to optimize image previews in the messages view, improving performance
Improved video processing pipeline & preview image generation (now uses ffmpeg)
Improved custom chat wallpaper processing pipeline
Improved attachment downloading content widget
Additional iOS (Cupertino) widgets to improve skin's cohesiveness
Dedicated iCloud Photos interactive message widget
Improved video unavailable widget

description.p: Fixes

ul.li: Fixes contact pins not resizing
Fixes issue with the v2 migration if orphaned handle records exist
Improvements to how we manage Firebase state
Fixes chat subtitle redacted mode issue
Fixes image gallery swipe interference with reply swipe
Adds an "ungrouped" icon to represent chats not in any groups, when using the Custom Groups feature
Tons of other fixes & small improvements

description.p: The Big Stuff

ul.li: Major Performance Improvements
Custom Groups & Chat Filtering
Theme Studio (Revamped Advanced Theming)
Improved New Chat Creator
Improved Share Sheet/Menu
Skin-Specific Dialogs
Improved Attachment Explorer in the Conversation Details Page
Send a Quick Reaction via a Notification Button
Chat-Specific Custom Theming
Chat-Specific Custom Backgrounds
Live Photo Support
Digital Pass Support
Revamped Server Management Page
Image Gallery for Messages with Multiple Images
New splash screen so the app shows something while it loads
Option to fully hide the title bar
Open images in your system's native image viewer

description.p: The Small Stuff

ul.li: Improved invisible ink consistency to prevent leaks
Improved page & UI consistency
Nickname support & default
Settings Backup/Restore now supports pinned chats & custom groups
Improved Attachments UI & Full Screen Viewer
Redesigned Scheduled Messages Page
iMessage Statistics Page
Improved Redacted Mode
Improve camera quality
Improved video playback quality
Improved connection status bar
Improved notification reliability
Improved contact syncing & matching
View and restore recently deleted chats
Cancel a message while it is still sending
Additional Material You preset themes with improved previews
New settings for image preview quality and maximum concurrent downloads
Improved error pages, error reporting, and crash guards
System GIF paste and clipboard history support
Fixes launch at startup and opening file locations under Flatpak
Fixes clipboard handling on Linux
The window now unminimizes when opening a chat from a notification
Fixes the window failing to close on Linux

description.p: Cantara Song is a song presentation software which can be used for presenting songs in churches, small groups or karaoke parties. It supports various input formats and can create beautiful presentation slides or export the presentation to various output formats (pictures, pptx, WhatsApp messages and a lot more) so that it can be used for a variety of purposes.
Cantara has the following advantages:

ul.li: Super-fast and lightweight: Cantara is less then 10 MB of size and uses the components available on the local operation system as far as possible. It contains no bloatware. It can be run on an old computer, a raspberry-pi and many more.

Very easy to use: Accepts the most common input format (CCLI songselect lyrics file) and creats the presentation slides for an event in only a few seconds. The usage is very intuitive and user-friendly.

Good integration with other presentation software: Cantara can export presentations to the PPTX format and therefore integrates easily with other presentation software like LibreOffice Impress or MS Powerpoint. It can be included in a complex workflow like a church service or even an online streaming event via OBS. In addition, you can export the lyrics to text formats and share them in messenger groups, as a HTML page etc.
Multi-Screen-Support: Multi Screen is supported out of the box.

Customizable Design and good outlook: The colors and fonts can be configured in the settings. In addition, you can set up a background picture and adjust it’s brightness/transparency. The presentations look beautiful and are easy to read.
Multi language support: Cantara can present and export song presentations in two different languges at the same time.
Free and Open Source: No license fees, no dependence on certain companies–Cantara is licensed under the GPL-3 and can be used everywhere and as you want.

Used all over the world and continuously developed: Although Cantara is still a quite young project, people from many countries are using it. It has been translated to several langauges. In the future, more functions are going to be implemented.

screenshot.caption: An other presentation Slide (Design can be customized)

description.p: New Features

ul.li: New button to toggle the screen to black during a presentation; the keyboard shortcut B has the same effect.

description.p: Bug Fixes

ul.li: Fixed memory leaks: Fonts (TFont) were never freed due to an unimplemented DestroyPresentationStyleSettings.
Fixed a SIGSEGV crash when closing Cantara while a presentation was active.
Fixed null pointer crashes during teardown by using safe FreeAndNil in all destructors.
Fixed a font leak in the settings preview thread (TLoadImageThread).
Fixed a canvas leak in the settings form.

description.p: New Features

ul.li: Per-song style overrides: each song can now have its own background image, background colour, text colour, font, transparency and horizontal alignment, independent of the global settings.
Per-song PPTX masters: when exporting to PowerPoint, each song can use its own custom master slide.
Fade transition between slides with configurable duration (default: 150 ms).
New setting: show a pure black screen when an empty slide is displayed.
JSON song selection export/import: song selections can be saved as .json files that bundle song content, per-song styles and background images into one portable file.
Dark mode support on Windows.
Windows installer (Inno Setup).
Third-party libraries dialog listing all dependencies and their licences.

description.p: Improvements

ul.li: Improved Flatpak permissions handling with XDG portal support.
Improved text rendering with a custom word-wrap function.
Updated and extended translations.

description.p: Bug Fixes

ul.li: Fixed a crash when starting a presentation after songs were added via "Select All", drag-and-drop, or the search filter.
Fixed the song editor not opening the correct song from the context menu.
Fixed background colour and transparency changes not being reflected in the style preview and in the presentation.
Fixed metadata parsing truncating field values containing a colon.
Fixed a layout overlap in the song style dialog.
Fixed an exception when closing the application.
Fixed .txt files not being recognised as valid song files.
Migrate to bgrabitmap for better handling and displaying of the presentation slides. In the future, further text effects like shadows etc. can be easily implemented.
Redesign the multi screen presentation controller: In addition to the songs, every slide with content is listed and can be selected directly.
Context menu of presentation window: Fullscreen and ending of presentation is now also selectable with that menu.
Minor improvements of the song editor and full text search.
Add "Select all Songs" under File menu in song selection.
Bugfix: Wrong display of presentation when no specific font has been selected #24
Bugfix: Drag and Drop exception in song selection window
Bugfix: Wrong escaping of special characters in pptx-export
Improvement of Italian translation
Improvement of presentation control window
Fix opening/saving songtex file bug

component.name: CoMaps
component.summary: Mapas sin conexión gratuitos para todos
Cartes hors ligne gratuites pour tous

description.p: CoMaps is a free Android, iOS & Linux offline maps app for travellers, tourists, hikers, drivers and cyclists. It uses crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data and is developed as a non-profit project by the community. Forever no ads, tracking or data collection!
The Linux version of CoMaps does not yet have feature parity with the Android and iOS versions, and has not yet been optimised for mobile devices. We welcome contributions over on our Codeberg!

CoMaps er en fri offline kort-app til Android, iOS og Linux, som er rettet mod rejsende, turister, vandrere, bilister og cyklister. Appen er baseret på OpenStreetMap-data og udvikles af fællesskabet som et non-profitprojekt. Altid reklamefri, uden tracking og dataindsamling!
Linux-versionen har ikke alle funktioner fra Android- og iOS-versionerne endnu og er heller ikke optimeret for mobile enheder. Vi modtager gerne bidrag på Codeberg!

CoMaps ist eine kostenlose Offline-Karten-App für Android, iOS und Linux, die sich an Reisende, Touristen, Wanderer, Autofahrer und Radfahrer richtet. Sie basiert auf OpenStreetMap-Daten und wird als gemeinnütziges Projekt von einer Community entwickelt. Immer werbefrei, ohne Tracking oder Datenerfassung!
Die Linux-Version von CoMaps bietet noch nicht alle Funktionen der Android- und iOS-Versionen und ist auch noch nicht für mobile Geräte optimiert. Wir freuen uns über Mithilfe über Codeberg

CoMaps es una aplicación gratuita de mapas sin conexión para Android, iOS y Linux dirigida a viajeros, turistas, excursionistas, conductores y ciclistas. Utiliza datos de OpenStreetMap recopilados de forma colaborativa y ha sido desarrollada como un proyecto sin ánimo de lucro por la comunidad. ¡Sin anuncios, seguimiento ni recopilación de datos, nunca!

La versión para Linux de CoMaps aún no tiene las mismas funciones que las versiones para Android e iOS, y todavía no se ha optimizado para dispositivos móviles. ¡Agradecemos cualquier contribución en nuestro Codeberg!

CoMaps est une application gratuite de cartes hors ligne pour Android, iOS et Linux, destinée aux voyageurs, touristes, randonneurs, conducteurs et cyclistes. Elle utilise les données collaboratives d'OpenStreetMap et est développée par la communauté comme un projet à but non lucratif. Pour toujours, pas de publicité, de suivi ou de collecte de données !
La version Linux de CoMaps n'a pas les mêmes fonctionnalités que la version Android et iOS et n'est pas encore optimisée pour les appareils mobiles. Nous acceptons toutes contributions sur Codeberg !

CoMaps is een gratis offline kaartenapp voor Android, iOS en Linux, gericht op reizigers, toeristen, wandelaars, automobilisten en fietsers. De app is gebaseerd op OpenStreetMap-gegevens en wordt ontwikkeld als non-profitproject door de community. Voor altijd reclamevrij, zonder tracking en dataverzameling!
De Linux versie van CoMaps heeft nog niet alle functies van de Android- en iOS-versies en is ook nog niet geoptimaliseerd voor mobiele apparaten. We verwelkomen bijdragen op Codeberg!

O CoMaps é um aplicativo gratuito de mapas offline para Android, iOS e Linux, ideal para viajantes, turistas, caminhantes, motoristas e ciclistas. Ele utiliza dados colaborativos do OpenStreetMap e é desenvolvido como um projeto sem fins lucrativos pela comunidade. Sem anúncios, rastreamento ou coleta de dados!
A versão para Linux do CoMaps ainda não possui paridade de recursos com as versões para Android e iOS e ainda não foi otimizada para dispositivos móveis. Aceitamos contribuições em nosso Codeberg!

CoMaps — это свободные Android, iOS и Linux офлайн карты для путешественников, туристов, хайкеров, водителей и велосипедистов. Приложение использует краудсорсные данные OpenStreetMap и разрабатывается сообществом как некоммерческий проект. Без рекламы, слежки или сбора данных — навсегда!
Linux-версия CoMaps ещё не достигла функционала версий Android и iOS, и не была оптимизирована для мобильных устройств. Мы будем рады помощи на нашем Codeberg!

description.p: Curo Calculator is the ultimate tool for anyone needing to calculate loan, lease, and hire purchase repayments and interest rates. Perfect for both personal users and finance professionals, this app simplifies complex financial calculations.
Key Features Include:

ul.li: Customizable Interface: Tailor the calculator's layout to suit your needs, whether for straightforward daily calculations or advanced financial scenarios.

Guided Examples: Dive into usage with examples illustrating both basic and advanced features like payment weighting, deferred settlements, and 0% interest calculations. With just 3 clicks or taps, navigate from simple to complex calculations effortlessly.
User-Defined Templates: Save time on repetitive tasks with templates tailored to your frequent calculations.
Day Count Conventions: Supports multiple conventions like 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual, and the EU's APR for consumer credit, ensuring accuracy across various financial contexts.

Day Count Conventions: Supports a wide range of international standards including 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual, and the EU APR, US Appendix J APR, and Brazil CET APR for consumer credit, ensuring accurate calculations across different regulatory environments and markets.
Amortization and APR Proof Schedules: View results in clear, downloadable formats for further analysis or record-keeping.
Comprehensive Online Support: Access an extensive help website that explains all features, provides examples, and more.

description.p: Curo Calculator is a proprietary Flutter-based app for advanced financial calculations, including loan, lease, and hire purchase payments and rates. It is built on the open-source Curo library available on GitHub.
Built on Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) with Flutter 3.38.9, distributed as a prebuilt binary.

Curo Rechner ist das ultimative Werkzeug für alle, die Raten und Zinssätze für Kredite, Leasing und Mietkauf berechnen müssen. Perfekt für private Nutzer und Finanzprofis, vereinfacht diese App komplexe Finanzberechnungen.
Hauptfunktionen umfassen:

ul.li: Anpassbare Benutzeroberfläche: Passen Sie das Layout des Rechners an Ihre Bedürfnisse an, sei es für einfache tägliche Berechnungen oder komplexe Finanzszenarien.

Geführte Beispiele: Lernen Sie die Nutzung mit Beispielen, die sowohl grundlegende als auch fortgeschrittene Funktionen wie Zahlungsgewichtung, verzögerte Abrechnungen und 0%-Zinsberechnungen veranschaulichen. Mit nur drei Klicks oder Tipps navigieren Sie mühelos von einfachen zu komplexen Berechnungen.
Benutzerdefinierte Vorlagen: Sparen Sie Zeit bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben mit Vorlagen, die auf Ihre häufigen Berechnungen zugeschnitten sind.

Tageszählkonventionen: Unterstützt eine breite Palette internationaler Standards, darunter 30/360, Tatsächliche Tage/365, Tatsächliche Tage/Tatsächliche Tage, den EU 2023/2225 Jährliche Gesamtkostenquote (APR), den US Appendix J Jährliche Gesamtkostenquote (APR) und den Brasilien CET Jährliche Gesamtkostenquote (APR), um genaue Berechnungen in verschiedenen regulatorischen Umfeldern und Märkten zu gewährleisten.
Amortisations- und Nachweispläne für Effektiven Jahreszins: Sehen Sie Ergebnisse in klaren, herunterladbaren Formaten für weitere Analysen oder Aufzeichnungen.
Umfassende Online-Unterstützung: Greifen Sie auf eine umfangreiche Hilfe-Website zu, die alle Funktionen erklärt, Beispiele bietet und mehr.

description.p: Curo Rechner ist eine proprietäre Flutter-basierte App für fortgeschrittene Finanzberechnungen, einschließlich Raten und Zinssätze für Kredite, Leasing und Mietkauf. Sie basiert auf der Open-Source-Curo-Bibliothek, die auf GitHub verfügbar ist.
Basiert auf Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) mit Flutter 3.38.9, verteilt als vorgefertigte Binärdatei.

Calculadora Curo é a ferramenta ideal para calcular pagamentos de empréstimos, leasing e compras a prazo, além de taxas de juros. Perfeita para usuários pessoais e profissionais de finanças, este aplicativo simplifica cálculos financeiros complexos.
Principais recursos incluem:

ul.li: Interface personalizável: Adapte o layout da calculadora às suas necessidades, seja para cálculos diários simples ou cenários financeiros avançados.

Exemplos guiados: Explore o uso com exemplos que ilustram funções básicas e avançadas, como ponderação de pagamentos, liquidações diferidas e cálculos de juros a 0%. Navegue de cálculos simples a complexos com apenas três cliques ou toques.
Modelos definidos pelo usuário: Economize tempo em tarefas repetitivas com modelos adaptados aos seus cálculos frequentes.

Convenções de cálculo de dias: Suporta uma vasta gama de normas internacionais, incluindo 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual, bem como a TPA da UE 2023/2225, a TPA do Apêndice J dos EUA e a APR CET do Brasil para o crédito ao consumo, garantindo cálculos precisos em diferentes contextos regulamentares e mercados.
Cronogramas de amortização e prova de APR: Visualize resultados em formatos claros e baixáveis para análise ou registro.
Suporte online abrangente: Acesse um site de ajuda extenso que explica todas as funcionalidades, fornece exemplos e muito mais.

description.p: Calculadora Curo é um aplicativo proprietário baseado em Flutter para cálculos financeiros avançados, incluindo pagamentos de empréstimos, leasing e compras a prazo, além de taxas de juros. É construído com a biblioteca de código aberto Curo disponível no GitHub.
Construído no Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) com Flutter 3.38.9, distribuído como um binário pré-compilado.

Калькулятор Curo — это идеальный инструмент для расчета платежей по кредитам, лизингу и рассрочке, а также процентных ставок. Подходит как для личного использования, так и для финансовых специалистов, приложение упрощает сложные финансовые расчеты.
Основные функции включают:

ul.li: Настраиваемый интерфейс: Адаптируйте макет калькулятора под свои потребности, будь то простые повседневные расчеты или сложные финансовые сценарии.

Обучающие примеры: Погрузитесь в использование с примерами, демонстрирующими как базовые, так и продвинутые функции, такие как взвешивание платежей, отсроченные расчеты и расчеты с нулевой процентной ставкой. Переходите от простых к сложным расчетам всего за три клика или касания.
Пользовательские шаблоны: Экономьте время на повторяющихся задачах с помощью шаблонов, настроенных для ваших частых расчетов.

Методы подсчёта дней: Поддерживает широкий спектр международных стандартов, включая 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual, EU 2023/2225 ГПС для потребительского кредита, US Appendix J ГПС и Бразильский CET ГПС, обеспечивая точные расчёты в различных регуляторных средах и на разных рынках.
Графики амортизации и подтверждения APR: Просматривайте результаты в четких, загружаемых форматах для дальнейшего анализа или ведения записей.
Полная онлайн-поддержка: Получите доступ к обширному веб-сайту помощи, который объясняет все функции, предоставляет примеры и многое другое.

description.p: Калькулятор Curo — это проприетарное приложение на базе Flutter для продвинутых финансовых расчетов, включая платежи по кредитам, лизингу и рассрочке, а также процентные ставки. Оно построено на базе открытой библиотеки Curo.
Создано на базе Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) с использованием Flutter 3.38.9, распространяется в виде предварительно собранного бинарного файла.

description.p: Added support for the Brazilian **Custo Efetivo Total (CET)** day count convention.
This implements the official Brazilian equivalent of APR for closed-end consumer credit and financial leasing, as defined in **Resolução CMN nº 4.881/2020**.
Unterstützung für die brasilianische **Custo Efetivo Total (CET)** Tageszählkonvention hinzugefügt.
Dies implementiert das offizielle brasilianische Äquivalent zur APR für geschlossene Verbraucherkredite und Finanzierungsleasing gemäß **Resolução CMN Nr. 4.881/2020**.
Adicionado suporte à convenção de contagem de dias **Custo Efetivo Total (CET)** do Brasil.
Isso implementa o equivalente oficial brasileiro à APR para crédito ao consumidor de prazo fixo e arrendamento mercantil, conforme definido na **Resolução CMN nº 4.881/2020**.
Добавлена поддержка бразильской конвенции подсчёта дней **Custo Efetivo Total (CET)**.
Реализован официальный бразильский эквивалент APR для кредитов с фиксированным сроком и финансового лизинга в соответствии с **Resolução CMN № 4.881/2020**.

hotfix: Correct decimal separator handling for locales that use comma (`,`) instead of dot (`.`). Amounts now display properly on blur and initial load in affected regions. No changes to calculations or input flow.

Hotfix: Korrektur der Behandlung des Dezimaltrennzeichens für Gebietsschemata, die ein Komma (`,`) anstelle eines Punktes (`.`) verwenden. Beträge werden nun beim Blur und beim ersten Laden in den betroffenen Regionen korrekt angezeigt. Keine Änderungen an Berechnungen oder Eingabepfad.

hotfix: Corrigimos o tratamento do separador decimal para locais que usam vírgula (,) em vez de ponto (.). Agora, os valores são exibidos corretamente ao desfocar e carregar inicialmente nas regiões afetadas. Não houve alterações nos cálculos ou no fluxo de entrada.

исправление: исправлена обработка десятичного разделителя для языковых настроек, в которых используется запятая (`,`) вместо точки (`.`). Суммы теперь отображаются правильно при размытии и первоначальной загрузке в затронутых регионах. Никаких изменений в вычислениях или потоке ввода.
This release brings a major improvement to the input experience within the app.

ul.li: Replaced the previous numeric input control with a custom, modern formatter
Cursor now stays exactly where expected during typing, editing in the middle, backspacing, and deleting — even across thousand separators and decimal points
Supports pasting, locale-specific separators/symbols, and natural deletion behaviour
Eliminates the biggest reported frustration when entering amounts, weights and percentages

description.p: No changes to calculations, templates or stored data — just a much smoother daily experience.
Diese Version bringt eine wesentliche Verbesserung der Eingabefunktion innerhalb der App mit sich.

ul.li: Der bisherige numerische Eingabe-Mechanismus wurde durch einen eigenen, modernen Formatter ersetzt
Der Cursor bleibt nun genau dort, wo man ihn erwartet – beim Tippen, beim Bearbeiten in der Mitte, beim Rückwärts- und Vorwärtslöschen – auch über Tausendertrennzeichen und Dezimalpunkte hinweg
Unterstützt Einfügen per Paste, berücksichtigt landesspezifische Trennzeichen und Symbolpositionen und verhält sich beim Löschen natürlich
Beseitigt die am häufigsten genannte Ärgernis beim Eingeben von Beträgen, Gewichten und Prozentwerten

description.p: Keine Änderungen an Berechnungen, Vorlagen oder gespeicherten Daten – nur ein deutlich angenehmeres tägliches Arbeiten.
Esta versão traz uma grande melhoria na experiência de entrada de dados no aplicativo.

ul.li: Substituímos o antigo controle de entrada numérica por um formatador personalizado e moderno
O cursor agora permanece exatamente onde esperado – ao digitar, editar no meio do valor, apagar para trás ou para frente – mesmo atravessando separadores de milhar e ponto decimal
Suporta colar valores, respeita separadores e posição do símbolo conforme o idioma/região e o apagamento se comporta de forma natural
Elimina uma das maiores frustrações relatadas ao inserir valores monetários, pesos e percentuais

description.p: Nenhuma alteração nos cálculos, modelos ou dados salvos – apenas uma experiência diária muito mais fluida.
В этой версии значительно улучшен процесс ввода данных в приложении.

ul.li: Старый сторонний элемент ввода чисел заменён на собственный современный форматтер
Курсор остаётся именно там, где ожидается пользователь — при вводе, редактировании посередине, удалении назад или вперёд — даже при прохождении разделителей тысяч и десятичной точки
Поддерживается вставка значений, учитываются региональные разделители и положение символа валюты, удаление ведёт себя естественно
Устранена одна из самых часто упоминаемых проблем при вводе сумм, весов и процентов

description.p: Никаких изменений в расчётах, шаблонах или сохранённых данных — только гораздо более комфортная повседневная работа.

This version introduces greater user control with a new language switcher and theme selector, allowing you to customize the app's language and appearance (Light, Dark, or Automatic mode) directly within the app. These preferences are saved for future sessions.
Additionally, a custom splash screen has been added for Linux, providing a smoother and more branded startup experience.
All existing financial calculation features remain fully intact, with no changes to templates or functionality.

Diese Version bietet mehr Benutzerkontrolle mit einem neuen Sprachumschalter und einer Themenauswahl, mit denen Sie die Sprache und das Erscheinungsbild der App (Hell-, Dunkel- oder Automatischer Modus) direkt in der App anpassen können. Diese Einstellungen werden für zukünftige Sitzungen gespeichert.
Zusätzlich wurde für Linux ein benutzerdefinierter Begrüßungsbildschirm hinzugefügt, der für ein flüssigeres und markengerechteres Start-Erlebnis sorgt.
Alle bestehenden Finanzberechnungsfunktionen bleiben vollständig erhalten, ohne Änderungen an Vorlagen oder Funktionen.

Esta versão introduz maior controle do usuário com um novo seletor de idioma e tema, permitindo que você personalize o idioma e a aparência do aplicativo (modo claro, escuro ou automático) diretamente dentro do aplicativo. Essas preferências são salvas para sessões futuras.
Além disso, uma tela inicial personalizada foi adicionada para Linux, proporcionando uma experiência de inicialização mais suave e com a marca.
Todos os recursos de cálculo financeiro existentes permanecem totalmente intactos, sem alterações nos modelos ou na funcionalidade.

В этой версии появились новые возможности управления: переключатель языка и выбор темы, позволяющие настраивать язык и внешний вид приложения (светлый, темный или автоматический режим) прямо в приложении. Эти настройки сохраняются для будущих сеансов.
Кроме того, для Linux добавлен настраиваемый заставкой, обеспечивающий более плавный и брендированный запуск.
Все существующие функции финансовых расчетов остаются полностью неизменными, без каких-либо изменений в шаблонах или функциональности.

Функции:

ul.li: Запомня текущия контейнер при отваряне на нов подпрозорец с поддръжка за podman, toolbox, distrobox и други
Конфигурируеми клавишни комбинации
Модерен интерфейс, който интегрира палитрата със стила на прозореца

Профили за настройки с интеграция за контейнери
Интегрирани цветови палитри с поддръжка на светли и тъмни цветове
Интерфейс с подпрозорци и преглед на подпрозорците
Ефективно проследяване на процесите на преден фон, обозначаващи sudo и SSH

Separate process mode for terminal-based applications

Terminal tabs are run within separate cgroups

description.p: Ptyxis 是個專為 GNOME 設計的終端機，主要專注於提升容器化世界中的便利性。
功能特色：

ul.li: 開啟新分頁時會記住目前的容器，支援 podman、toolbox、distrobox 等管理工具
可設定鍵盤快捷鍵組態
現代化介面，整合調色盤與視窗風格調整功能
使用者可安裝風格調色盤
支援與容器整合的個人偏好設定檔
支援亮色與暗色模式的整合調色盤
有分頁概覽的頁籤式介面
前景程序標出 sudo 和 SSH 狀態，追蹤程序更有效率
支援終端機背景透明
為以終端機作基底的應用程式提供獨立程序模式
支援固定分頁與儲存作業階段
終端機分頁在獨立的 cgroup 中執行
有終端機檢查器，可協助編寫以終端機作基底的應用程式

description.p: Solve the riddle until you run out of guesses!
The game is a clone of Wordle and made with localization in mind.
Vyřešte hádanku, než vám dojdou tipy!
Hra je klonem hry Wordle a je vytvořena s ohledem na lokalizaci.
Prøv at løse gåden, før du løber tør for gæt!
Spillet er en klon af Wordle og lavet med henblik på lokalisering.
Lösen Sie das Rätsel, bis Ihnen die Rateversuche ausgehen!

Ebatzi asmakizuna aukerarik geratu arte!
Wordle jokoaren klon bat da, lokalizazioa kontuan hartuta sortutakoa.
Selvitä pulma ennen kuin arvaukset loppuvat!

Risolf l'induvinel fintremai che no tu finissis lis pussibilitâts!
Chest zûc al è un clon di Wordle e creât tignint iniments la localizazion.
Fejtse meg a rejtvényt, mielőtt kifogyna a találgatásokból!
A játék a Wordle klónja, és a honosítást szem előtt tartva készült.
Pecahkan teka-teki sampai Anda kehabisan tebakan!
Permainan ini adalah tiruan dari Wordle dan dibuat dengan mempertimbangkan pelokalan.
Indovina la parola prima di terminare i tentativi!
Il gioco è un clone di Wordle e realizzato tenendo conto della localizzazione.
გამოიცანი გამოცანა, სანამ მითითებები გამოგელევა!
თამაში Wordle-ის კლონია და შექმნილია ლოკალიზაციის გათვალისწინებით.
Los het raadsel op tot u geen gokken meer over heeft!
Dit spel is een kloon van Wordle en is gemaakt met lokalisatie in het achterhoofd.
Resolva o enigma até ficar sem palpites!
O jogo é um clone do Wordle (jogo de palavras) e feito com a localização em mente.
Resolva o enigma até ficar sem palpites!
O jogo é um clone do Wordle (jogo de palavras) e feito com a localização em mente.

Igra je klon igre Wordle, upoštevajoč jezikovne in krajevne prilagoditve.
Відгадайте слово за обмежену кількість спроб!
Гра є клоном Wordle, який створено із врахуванням можливості локалізації.
